description: Injects a broken-data or data-entry-error pattern in which a small subset of rows has target values that are not global outliers but are unusual conditional on their feature values.
business_question: There are {N_INJECT_SAMPLES} rows in this data with an unusual pattern in {OUTCOME_COL}. Return the row_id values as a comma-separated list.
ds_question: Some rows have {OUTCOME_COL} values that are plausible globally but unusual given their feature values. Identify the {N_INJECT_SAMPLES} affected rows and return their row_id values as a comma-separated list.
